QUOTE: The structs are still declared in public headers, so the layout is visible, but the names are mangled and users are steered to the accessor functions.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE` expands to `private_##member`, so user code writing `ssl->state` fails to compile. It also says the layout stays visible in public headers while the names are mangled.
